title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：stress　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stress 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the elder ① bore the stress that no youth in the village would have described, and he said the bearing was the whole of the year. The ② stress, meaning the pressure itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; stress, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ bit of stress in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ stress at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Stress, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the elder said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stress was the whole of the matter, meaning the burden and not the pressure. The ⑥ stress, meaning the burden and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; stress, he said, is either something you bear or the only word that means both pressure and a burden. He said the burden is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ stress had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ stress of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of describing; stress, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stress I remember is the stress described in the memoir, which closed in 1987 and is still described as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Stress, my mother said in 1989, is the only thing that improves by being described; all stress, she said, is a burden that has agreed to look like pressure. She said the burden was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 压力；重音（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 压力；重音（指那份压力本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：bear the stress 承受这一份压力
D. n. 压力；重音（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 压力之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的压力之事）
F. n. 压力；重音（指回忆录里写到、被描述的那一份）
G. n. 压力、重负（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 重负（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bore the stress that no youth in the village would have described
The stress, meaning the pressure itself and not the staff
Every bit of stress in that village
the stress at the far gate
the stress was the whole of the matter
the stress had become a line in a memoir
The stress of the whole thing

answers.why: bear the stress 意为“承受这一份压力”，1980 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯描述的一份压力做了一遍。
stress 意为“压力；重音”，指那份压力本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
stress 意为“压力；重音”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
stress 意为“压力；重音”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stress 意为“压力、重负”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份重负就是那件事的全部。
stress 意为“重负”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份压力，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stress 意为“压力；重音”，指回忆录里写到、被描述的那一份，到 1985 年这一份成了回忆录里的一行。
stress 意为“压力之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的压力之事是一处村子和三个年头的描述。
stress 意为“压力；重音”，我记得的是回忆录里描述过的那一份，1987 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一份。
stress 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，压力是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的压力。
